GunSmithFramework.GunSmithPlatformDef.label: Z-750 binary rifle
GunSmithFramework.GunSmithPlatformDef.description: A heavy precision weapon that concentrates hardlight into an intensely energetic beam. Its elongated focusing assembly requires time to stabilize before releasing the charge, burning through distant targets in a brief flash. A narrow targeting beam marks the path of the impending discharge.\n\nThe entire weapon is printed in a molecular printer aboard the Aurora, which converts energy directly into matter.
